method: Read-only exact canonical_url lookup against content_items for all important reference URLs and five preserved Techmeme publisher aliases. fetched_at is the insert timestamp: ingestion upserts leave it unchanged. No title matching, model calls or production writes.
limits: Exact URL collection census, not event matching or recall. Missing aggregator URLs do not prove missing publisher reports. Post-cutoff insertion does not establish event omission. Publisher aliases were observed later and are not backdated.
query: select id,canonical_url,published_at,fetched_at from content_items where canonical_url = any($1::text[])
